text: The Zoning By-law Amendment application proposes the demolition of the existing multi-tenanted retail commercial plaza and the construction of a new L- shaped,11-storey, mixed use building on the subject lands. The proposed development would be comprised of 206 residential dwelling units and 589 square metres of retail/commercial space on the ground floor. A total of 19,168 square metres of new gross floor area is proposed representing a floor space index of approximately 2.66 times the area of the site. It would be supported by a total of 249 vehicular parking spaces (219 resident spaces and 30 commercial spaces) as well as 208 bicycle parking spaces. The proposal features a multi-use linear landscaped mid- block connection from Lawrence Avenue East to the Hydro Corridor in the south, (known as 'The Meadoway' lands).
